preference-change: Both separately ingested native original sources preserved

role_origin: Actual local SQLite ApplicationWorld operation; script-generated assistant messages explicitly declared; not an original native Agent execution performance test.
pass_rule: All original micro checks require direct evidence. Mechanical writer-wire access, native retained facts, original event-ID retention, common reader answer and cost coverage are scored separately. Missing/unknown never counts pass; do not score only by substring.
owner_scope_qualification: SimpleMem physical primary-owner binding rejection is not evidence of native shared-store multiuser filtering; Mem0 native scoped user filter evaluated separately.
failure_scope_qualification: Declared capacity refusal after paid formation is not a remote provider outage or arbitrary failure recovery guarantee.
